select apply.*, `user`.name as userName, course.name as courseName, course.price as coursePrice, course.duration as courseDuration, coach.coach as coachName from `apply` left join `user` on `apply`.user_id=`user`.id left join `course` on `apply`.course_id=`course`.id left join `coach` on `course`.coach_id=`coach`.id
and apply.title like concat('%',#{title},'%') and apply.user_id = #{userId} and apply.course_id = #{courseId} and `user`.name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
order by apply.id desc
